 "content": "from collections import Counter

def _mode(xs):
    return Counter(xs).most_common(1)[0][0]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [_mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [_mode(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
    rc, cc = Counter(row_modes), Counter(col_modes)
    shared = set(rc) & set(cc)
    # Grid separators have a color that is a minority of the dominant row/column
    # colors; ordinary tile interiors provide the majority class.
    line_color = min(shared, key=lambda color: rc[color] + cc[color])
    ys = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == line_color]
    xs = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == line_color]
    if len(ys) < 2 or len(xs) < 2:
        return [[_mode(v for row in grid for v in row)]]

    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in xs] for r in ys]
    special = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(nodes)
               for j, value in enumerate(row) if value != line_color]
    if not special:
        return [[_mode(v for row in grid for v in row)]]
    r0 = min(i for i, j in special)
    r1 = max(i for i, j in special)
    c0 = min(j for i, j in special)
    c1 = max(j for i, j in special)
    fill = _mode(v for row in grid for v in row)
    out = [[fill for _ in range(c1 - c0)] for _ in range(r1 - r0)]
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            a, b = nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1]
            c, d = nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1]
            if a != line_color and a == b == c == d:
                out[i - r0][j - c0] = a
    return out
